description: Background job: go to a position (or a remembered place by id) in path-finding segments, routing around obstacles and stopping if health gets low. Walks, swims, climbs ladders, opens doors, and where needed digs through blocks and pillars up on cobblestone/dirt from the hotbar. Longer range than navigate_to. Returns a job id at once.

allowDig.description: Dig through blocks when going around is longer.

allowPillar.description: Pillar up on throwaway blocks from the hotbar.

place.description: Memory id of a place to go to instead of coordinates.

waitSeconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the job to finish before returning (default 0: return at once).

y.description: Defaults to the mapped surface height there, else your height.

name: travel_to
title: Travel to a position (job)
